# Agent Python Tools

- repo: pytorch/pytorch
- repo_uri: https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch.git

## File: pytorch_pytorch/torch/ao/nn/quantized/functional.py

Prompts

```
['build a quantized 2D convolution on quantized input and weight tensors with bias and scale parameters', 'create a quantized linear transformation on quantized input and weight tensors with optional bias and scale', 'test the quantized 2D average pooling function on a quantized input tensor with kernel size and stride', 'run the quantized leaky_relu activation function on a quantized input tensor with negative slope parameter', 'refactor the quantized interpolate function to upsample a quantized 2D or 3D input tensor with bilinear mode']
```

Usage

```
{'build_quantized_conv2d': 'build a quantized 2D convolution on quantized input and weight tensors with bias and scale parameters', 'create_quantized_linear': 'create a quantized linear transformation on quantized input and weight tensors with optional bias and scale', 'test_quantized_avg_pool2d': 'test the quantized 2D average pooling function on a quantized input tensor with kernel size and stride', 'run_quantized_relu': 'run the quantized leaky_relu activation function on a quantized input tensor with negative slope parameter', 'refactor_quantized_interpolate': 'refactor the quantized interpolate function to upsample a quantized 2D or 3D input tensor with bilinear mode'}
```
